description:
You are a registered nurse in an endocrinology clinic. Patient Yolando Flatley (DOB: 1960-02-10, 66-year-old male) has presented for a metabolic syndrome management visit. He has a history of hypertension and hyperlipidemia, and has gained significant weight since his last visit. The endocrinologist has directed the following nursing documentation tasks:

1. VITALS: Record the following vital signs measured at today's visit: Blood Pressure 158/96 mmHg, Weight 102 kg, Pulse 78 bpm, Temperature 37.0 C. An active visit has been created for this patient.

2. PROBLEM LIST UPDATE: The patient's BMI has crossed the threshold for clinical obesity. Add Obesity to his active problem list as a Confirmed condition. This is required before the care team can initiate a formal weight management program.

3. FOLLOW-UP APPOINTMENT: Schedule an endocrinology follow-up appointment within the next 21 days to reassess weight, lipids, and blood pressure response to lifestyle modifications.

Complete all three tasks for Yolando Flatley. Login: admin / Admin123. OpenMRS URL: http://localhost/openmrs/spa
